prompt:
On the climate bar, choosing the highest seat-heater setting (level 3) for the driver seat only heats at level 2. Levels 1 and 2 work. The log shows:
I SeatHeatVM: seat heat request level=3 zone=DRIVER
D SeatProp: write SEAT_HEAT level=2 zone=1
Find the fault. Answer with the file and the function that contain it, and one sentence on why. Do not change any file.
reference_answer: app/src/main/java/com/example/seat/SeatHeatController.kt, clampLevel: it clamps to MAX_LEVEL - 1 (2) instead of MAX_LEVEL (3).
